method: no new search — checked against the evidence already recorded for charter_ny_publication, which propagation.mjs named as the clause this one was built from. The question was whether the same defect is present, and the sources establishing it are already on file.

assertions.text: publication must run for six successive weeks
the Certificate of Publication must be filed within 120 days of formation

assertions.note: the number is right; what is missing is recorded as a gap below

gaps: The parent defect propagated: the two papers are not interchangeable — the county clerk designates one daily and one weekly. "Two designated newspapers" reads as a free choice of any two, so a founder can publish in two dailies, satisfy this clause, and fail the statute. Confirmed in charter_ny_publication and repeated verbatim in substance here.
